acceptance.player: Unreachable as an arrangement. No New Haven bank arranges an overdraft (Chase, Bank of America and Wells Fargo charge by the item; Citi and Capital One have no overdraft terms), so a student’s request is refused in her bank’s words with nothing set or posted, across a reload, and Chase’s panel draws no Arrange It (tests/scope-money.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: at each New Haven bank the request is refused in the bank’s words…’). From 2026-10-16 a student may keep an account at a bank in the country she lived in before Yale (systems/homeaccount.ts), and it doesn’t reach this either: a bank abroad opens nothing new for a customer abroad, an overdraft among them, and refuses it in its words (abroadRefusal, systems/abroad.ts; bank.arrange_overdraft, lending.ts). Read again on 2026-10-16 (brief 09): the coverage area’s probe of brief 09 (probe/coverage09/bank-rows.ts, its output in docs/verification/remaining-09/coverage-result.json, coverage09.3-unresolved) made a Yale life for each of the 55 banks abroad SLATE has research on, the account kept at home opened on 1 August 2026, or for a life there from 2008 on the day she reached the bank’s opening age, a Comfortable family at Chase (54 of them kept; Japan Post Bank is refused at creation): the overdraft was refused on every account kept at home, in the bank’s own words (abroadRefusal).

Until 2026-10-13 this said no test earned the base period or left school through a command before claiming; tests/evidence2-b05.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: a Connecticut week is judged on most of its days (Regs. Conn. State Agencies §31-235-12): in hospital from Saturday morning over the Sunday it’s certified is paid $93, and laid up from Monday morning to Sunday noon is paid nothing’ (the stay and the injury put in by hand)
benefits.claim.issue: It can be reached from Summer Cabaret wages. Until 2026-10-10 every week was paid in full while work-study and Cabaret pay went on, with no availability or student check; since then a full-time student in Connecticut is refused, and a week certified abroad, in hospital, laid up or without permission to work pays nothing (unemployment.ts:254). Until 2026-10-13 a week was reduced by the wages paid in it, so a shift worked before the claim cut its first week (defect 59); since then by the work done in it (workDoneIn, unemployment.ts:262). Until 2026-10-13 availability was read on the Sunday certified alone; a Connecticut week is judged since on the major portion of its days (Regs. Conn. State Agencies §31-235-12; ableOnMost, unemployment.ts:198-201, each day kept as it begins at :205-210). The UK, Ireland and Mexico City branches can't be reached. See finding 4.

i-stale-claims.explanation: Until 2026-10-10: docs/capabilities.json and docs/CAPABILITIES.md named enjoyment’s loved interests, capabilities.json the reading interest’s enjoyment (READ_CRAFTS, which no longer exists), and src/ui/looks/actor.tsx and src/engine/systems/life.ts named an interest in the present tense. Until 2026-10-13 four more said the interests in the present tense: migration 92's comment in src/engine/index.ts, tests/attributes-matrix.test.ts:4, tests/looks.test.ts:491-492 and docs/UNBITTEN.md:112. Each is in the past tense since. From 2026-10-15 the tree is held to a stricter rule, a heuristic over the words rather than a parser, which catches the shapes its tests name: a present passive ('is dropped'), 'went into', 'went on' and 'went in', a possessive or adjective singular of up to two adjectives ('her own favorite interest'), any present or future verb with the interests as subject, past a clause set off by commas, beside a past clause; and which reads the present perfect ('have been removed') as the past.

Until 2026-10-16 the button was drawn shut on every lien; from then it’s drawn only on a lien the engine finds was filed in error, and a played student’s Connecticut lien says why in the engine’s words, the command refused (tests/remaining-tax.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: her Connecticut lien, filed by the clock 60 days after the due date…’). acceptance.player: Unreachable: Connecticut’s lien always secures tax still owed, since a payment goes to the penalty and interest first, a lien is filed only while something is owed, and DRS assesses from the return’s own figures. Since 2026-10-16 the button is drawn only on a lien filed in error; on a played student’s Connecticut lien Papers says why in the engine’s words and the command is refused (tests/remaining-tax.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: her Connecticut lien, filed by the clock 60 days after the due date…’). Read again on 2026-10-16 (brief 09): unchanged. An Inherited family’s student who files nothing has Connecticut liens filed by the clock on 2026, 2027 and 2028, each securing tax still owed and each paid by DRS’s levy 30 days on (probe/coverage09/tax-lien.ts), none of them in error: DRS’s assessment of a return never filed is the return’s own figure (assessStateNonFiler), so her own in its place owes the same.
